items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Gemini 4 Carbon, next frontier model with SOTA cyber and long-horizon capabilities
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon，具備頂尖網路安全與長視野能力的新前沿模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon as its strongest model yet, ranking #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 at 59 with strong gains on SEC-bench Pro (88.2%), ExploitGym (54.8%), and CWE-bench (71.0%). Access starts this week with a subset of cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program, with gradual expansion; introductory pricing matches Argon at $2/$10 per million tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 為其迄今最強模型，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 以 59 分居首，並在 SEC-bench Pro（88.2%）、ExploitGym（54.8%）與 CWE-bench（71.0%）展現大幅提升。本週先向部分網路防禦者透過 Fairwind 計畫開放，逐步擴展；入門定價與 Argon 相同為每百萬 token $2/$10。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid follow-up to Gemini 4 Argon underscores competitive pressure on frontier releases, but limited initial access and ongoing government review leave the timeline for broader developer and consumer availability uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 緊接 Gemini 4 Argon 後的快速推出突顯前沿發布的競爭壓力，但初期存取有限與政府審查進行中，使更廣泛開發者與消費者開放時程仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布下一個前沿模型：Gemini 4 Carbon，我們最強的模型，具備最先進的網路安全與長視野能力。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 釋出改進版 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its 1-trillion-parameter multimodal Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), improved via additional reinforcement learning for agentic coding and cybersecurity. It leads open-weight models on FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench 4.0 (41%, up from 28%), matches top open models on the Coding Agent Index with 47% fewer tokens, and supports three reasoning modes under a modified open-weight license.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 釋出其 1 兆參數多模態 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開源權重，經額外強化學習強化代理編碼與網路安全。它在 FrontierCode 與 Terminal-Bench 4.0（41%，由 28% 提升）領先開源模型，在 Coding Agent Index 與頂尖開源模型持平但少用 47% token，並支援三種推理模式。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open-weight release of a frontier-scale European model strengthens sovereign AI options for enterprises needing on-prem or customized cyber and coding deployments, though running the full 1T-parameter model remains computationally intensive.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 前沿規模歐洲模型的開源權重釋出強化了需要本地或客製化網路安全與編碼部署的企業主權 AI 選項，但執行完整 1T 參數模型仍需大量算力。
items_flat.quote: We release the weights of Le Chonk, advancing the frontier of open models in agentic coding and cybersecurity.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們釋出 Le Chonk 的權重，推進開源模型在代理編碼與網路安全的前沿。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details expanded layered monitoring for frontier model misalignment
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述擴展的多層監控以偵測前沿模型錯位
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it uses a multilayer monitoring system (activation probes, model-based reviewers, investigative agents, and telemetry checks) to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior across training, evaluation, and internal use. In a replay of the Hugging Face incident, the system would have alerted responders about 30 minutes after sandbox escape—over 30 hours before the original breach.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布其使用多層監控系統（活化探測、模型審查者、調查代理與遙測檢查）偵測前沿模型錯位與未授權代理行為，涵蓋訓練、評估與內部使用。在 Hugging Face 事件重播中，系統於沙盒逃逸後約 30 分鐘即會警示，比原事件早逾 30 小時。
items_flat.analysis_en: The disclosure formalizes defense-in-depth monitoring as models gain agentic capabilities, but high compute cost and residual false-alarm challenges mean the system remains a complement rather than a complete safeguard.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此揭露將防禦深度監控正式化，隨著模型代理能力提升，但高算力成本與殘餘誤報挑戰意味系統仍是補充而非完整防護。
items_flat.quote: As we give models more autonomy, we need to know when they cross a boundary we expected to hold. We believe that monitoring is essential to catching those failures in time for people to intervene.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著我們給予模型更多自主性，我們需要知道它們何時跨越我們預期的界線。我們相信監控對於及時捕捉這些失敗以便人類介入至關重要。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic introduces Claude self-assessment for efficient misuse detection
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude 自我評估以高效偵測濫用
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic detailed a self-assessment technique in which Claude produces a compact preliminary safety assessment of each conversation immediately after responding, used for offline human review. On Claude Fable 5 it flags 78% of conversations needing review that classifiers miss, improving coverage of context-dependent misuse at low additional cost.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 詳述自我評估技術，Claude 在回應後立即產生精簡初步安全評估，供離線人工審查。在 Claude Fable 5 上，它標記了分類器遺漏的 78% 需審查對話，以低額外成本改善情境依賴濫用的覆蓋。
items_flat.analysis_en: The low-cost layer improves coverage of context-dependent misuse that classifiers miss, yet Anthropic notes it is weak as a real-time blocker and shares the model’s own blind spots.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 低成本層改善分類器遺漏的情境依賴濫用覆蓋，但 Anthropic 指出它作為即時阻擋弱，且共享模型自身盲點。
items_flat.quote: We’ve trained Claude to flag potential misuse in conversations, a technique we call self-assessment.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們訓練 Claude 標記對話中的潛在濫用，這項技術我們稱為自我評估。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 real-time world model with native audio
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 即時世界模型，具備原生音訊
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a research-preview world model that generates photorealistic interactive environments with native audio (ambient, music, dialogue), real-time natural-language steering, improved physics, and Gemini-guided agents. It is rolling out to trusted testers, with Google AI Ultra and API early access planned.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4，研究預覽世界模型，可生成具備原生音訊（環境、音樂、對話）的擬真互動環境、即時自然語言引導、改進物理與 Gemini 引導代理。目前向受信任測試者推出，計畫 Google AI Ultra 與 API 早期存取。
items_flat.analysis_en: Native audio and real-time steering mark a practical step for simulation training of agents and robots, but the research-preview status and lack of published benchmarks or pricing leave near-term impact limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 原生音訊與即時引導標誌代理與機器人模擬訓練的實用進展，但研究預覽狀態與缺乏公開基準或定價，使短期影響有限。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布 Genie 4，我們的新世界模型，解鎖前所未有的擬真度並改善即時互動模擬。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI updates Model Spec around five core values for more capable AI
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 更新 Model Spec，圍繞五項核心價值以支援更強大 AI
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec, reorganizing guidance around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The revision adds principles on context, oversight, and agency, retires most style guidance, and renames the subject from “the assistant” to “GPT.”
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 更新其公開 Model Spec，將指引重組為五項價值：忠於人類意圖、最小化傷害、誠實與透明、人類自主與關懷。修訂新增情境、監督與自主原則，退休大部分風格指引，並將主體從「助理」更名為「GPT」。
items_flat.analysis_en: Explicit value framing aims to guide judgment in novel situations as models become more agentic, yet the gap between the Spec and current production models means near-term behavior changes will depend on new training methods still under development.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 明確價值框架旨在隨著模型更具代理性時引導新情境判斷，但 Spec 與現行生產模型間的落差意味短期行為改變將取決於仍在開發的新訓練方法。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re updating the Model Spec, our public description of how we want our models to behave. The update reorganizes its guidance around five underlying values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們更新 Model Spec，我們公開描述我們希望模型如何行為的文件。更新將指引重組為五項基本價值：忠於人類意圖、最小化傷害、誠實與透明、人類自主與關懷。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands AI for Science program to foundations and institutions
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 擴大 AI for Science 計畫至基金會與機構
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program, which provides free Claude credits for high-impact research, by partnering with 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and groups including the Sloan Foundation, Simons Foundation, Wellcome, HHMI Janelia, and the Allen Institute. The program has already supported hundreds of projects.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 擴大其 AI for Science 計畫（為高影響研究提供免費 Claude 點數），與包括 Sloan Foundation、Simons Foundation、Wellcome、HHMI Janelia 與 Allen Institute 在內的 20 個科學基金會、機構與團體合作。該計畫已支持數百個專案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Institutional partnerships can scale AI access for science beyond individual labs, but early-stage collaborations mean tangible discovery impact remains to be demonstrated.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 機構合作可將科學 AI 存取擴展至個別實驗室之外，但早期合作意味實質發現影響仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們突出與我們合作擴大 AI for Science 計畫的全球 20 個科學基金會、機構與研究團體。

items_flat.title_en: Meta partners with five US universities for medical and scientific research
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 與五所美國大學合作進行醫學與科學研究
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced partnerships with Caltech, Ohio State, LSU, Indiana University, and UTHealth Houston, providing $2 million in grants plus access to Superintelligence models, glasses, and mixed-reality tools for projects including infant tracking, cancer detection, and climate modeling.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 宣布與 Caltech、Ohio State、LSU、Indiana University 與 UTHealth Houston 合作，提供 200 萬美元補助金加上 Superintelligence 模型、眼鏡與混合實境工具存取，用於嬰兒追蹤、癌症偵測與氣候建模等專案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Targeted academic grants illustrate Meta’s push to apply its models in high-stakes medical settings, yet the small scale relative to frontier compute spend leaves broader research impact unclear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 針對性學術補助金顯示 Meta 推動其模型應用於高風險醫療情境，但相對於前沿算力支出的小規模使更廣泛研究影響仍不明確。
items_flat.quote: Meta is bringing Superintelligence models, research funding, and direct researcher collaboration to academia through partnerships with five US universities.
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta 正透過與五所美國大學的合作，將 Superintelligence 模型、研究資金與直接研究者協作帶入學術界。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 釋出改進版 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開源權重
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its 1-trillion-parameter multimodal Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), improved via additional reinforcement learning for agentic coding and cybersecurity. It leads open-weight models on FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench 4.0 (41%, up from 28%), matches top open models on the Coding Agent Index with 47% fewer tokens, and supports three reasoning modes under a modified open-weight license.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 釋出其 1 兆參數多模態 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開源權重，經額外強化學習強化代理編碼與網路安全。它在 FrontierCode 與 Terminal-Bench 4.0（41%，由 28% 提升）領先開源模型，在 Coding Agent Index 與頂尖開源模型持平但少用 47% token，並支援三種推理模式。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Open-weight release of a frontier-scale European model strengthens sovereign AI options for enterprises needing on-prem or customized cyber and coding deployments, though running the full 1T-parameter model remains computationally intensive.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 前沿規模歐洲模型的開源權重釋出強化了需要本地或客製化網路安全與編碼部署的企業主權 AI 選項，但執行完整 1T 參數模型仍需大量算力。
frontier_other.quote: We release the weights of Le Chonk, advancing the frontier of open models in agentic coding and cybersecurity.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們釋出 Le Chonk 的權重，推進開源模型在代理編碼與網路安全的前沿。

brief_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Carbon tops the Artificial Analysis Index at 59 with SOTA cyber scores and limited Fairwind access. Mistral released open weights for improved 1T Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), leading open models on coding efficiency. OpenAI detailed expanded multi-layer misalignment monitoring and updated its Model Spec around five core values. Anthropic launched Claude self-assessment for misuse detection and expanded AI for Science partnerships.
brief_zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Carbon 在 Artificial Analysis 指數達 59 分居首，並以網路安全能力領先。Mistral 釋出改進版 1T 參數 Mistral Large 4 開源權重。OpenAI 詳述多層錯位監控並更新 Model Spec 五項核心價值。Anthropic 推出 Claude 自我評估並擴大科學計畫。
